annotations.title: Install Emma on a business website

description: Returns how to install Emma (an AI receptionist app by Stimhaus) on a business website, for the given platform (wix, shopify, wordpress, or other for any other website): which app or plugin, where to get it, how it is installed, what the business owner must do, who bills, and what Emma does on that platform. Read-only: nothing is installed or changed by this tool. No key, no web address needed. The answer is an automated text from Emma, an AI.

business_name.description: optional: the business name, only used to fill data-name in the script tag (platform other)

platform.description: what the business website runs on; other = any other website

name: install_emma

app_name.description: the app or plugin to install

code.description: machine-readable reason when ok is false

how_an_agent_installs.description: what an agent with access to the site does

ok.description: true when the install steps are given

rule.description: an agent installs Emma; only the business owner activates her

script_tag.description: platform other: the tag to add before </body>

text.description: the whole answer, plain text — an automated answer from Emma, an AI

what_emma_does.description: what Emma does on this platform, by plan

full.description: null when there is no Full plan on this platform
